title: Clean-slate Canvas: Contextual Starter Templates and Inline Coaching for First 10 API Calls
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Goal: Reduce time-to-first-success for new Console users by providing a clean-slate (blank canvas) experience that surfaces contextual starter templates and an inline coaching layer that guides the user through their first 10 API calls. This ticket covers UX patterns, content, prototype assets, experiment design, and handoff artifacts for engineering implementation.

Background: New teams frequently drop out after creating an account because they are uncertain which model, endpoint, or request parameters to try first. Existing onboarding flows and tooltips are fragmented (see DES-4721 etc). We want a unified "first-run canvas" that balances activation with cost literacy—encouraging low-cost experiments (short prompts, small token budgets, embeddings quickstarts) while educating about batching, caching, and rollout semantics.

Scope: Design the blank-canvas entry surface for Console > Projects > Create > Try API. Deliverables: 1) Figma prototype full flow 2) UI copy for inline coaching and cost literacy cards 3) Interaction spec for tooltip lifecycle and dismissal heuristics 4) Analytics event contract 5) A/B test plan and success metrics 6) Handoff package for frontend + backend (feature flagging, experiment toggles).

Constraints & assumptions: Must work within current Console layout (sidebar + canvas). Tooltips should not block completion; can be dismissed or snoozed. Behaviour must respect enterprise privacy settings (no sample logs for Private deployments). Cost guidance should use aggregated per-route cost estimates (from product team) and avoid showing customer billing numbers.

Acceptance criteria: Users in the experiment cohort can finish 3 meaningful API calls within 24 hours of first sign-in at a 15% higher rate than baseline; tooltip CTR and template usage tracked; rollout can be toggled by feature flag; design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng; assets uploaded to Drive and Figma and linked in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Figma prototype (desktop + responsive) approved by PM and Eng.
2) Inline coaching microcopy vetted by legal/comms.
3) Analytics events documented (event names + properties).
4) Feature flag gating and canary rollout plan documented.
5) A/B experiment plan with metrics (activation, time-to-first-success, template reuse, cost-per-activation).
